dns.IPFamily: The IP address family: `4` for IPv4 or `6` for IPv6.
dns.lookup: Resolve `hostname` into an IP address using the operating system's `getaddrinfo` facility, not the DNS protocol directly. With `all: true`, the callback receives every resolved address instead of just the first.
dns.resolveTxt: Use the DNS protocol to resolve TXT records for `hostname`, on the global resolver. The callback receives an array of records, each itself an array of the strings that make up that record.
LookupOptions.family: Restrict resolution to `4` (IPv4) or `6` (IPv6), or `0` for either. Defaults to `0`.
LookupOptions.all: When `true`, resolve every address for `hostname` instead of just the first. Defaults to `false`.
DNSResolver: An independent resolver for DNS queries over the DNS protocol, with its own servers and local address. Each instance keeps its own set of outstanding queries, which `cancel()` aborts and `destroy()` releases.
DNSResolver.resolveTxt: Use the DNS protocol to resolve TXT records for `hostname`. The callback receives an array of records, each itself an array of the strings that make up that record.
